targets.outcome_quote:
These findings replicate the results reported by the original test
of ROM (Noor et al. 2008a) and related literature (Uluğ et al.

targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly confirm the original ROM findings. Multidimensional identity and conflict-type findings extend the model. Other cited studies supply related literature or measures rather than distinct findings this paper expressly re-tests.
